python3 -c "
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sales Data']

# Add header
h = ws.cell(row=1, column=8, value='Profit Margin')
h.font = Font(bold=True)
h.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')
h.fill = PatternFill('solid', start_color='DDEBF7')

# Add formulas for data rows (Profit / Revenue)
for r in range(2, 10):
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=8, value=f'=G{r}/E{r}')
    c.number_format = '0.0%'

# Total row margin
t = ws.cell(row=10, column=8, value='=G10/E10')
t.number_format = '0.0%'
t.font = Font(bold=True)

# Widen column
ws.column_dimensions['H'].width = 14

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
